description: This file defines the abstract class DrmEngineBase, an interface for DRM plugin developers, specifying virtual methods for DRM content handling, rights management, decryption, and plugin lifecycle management within the Android DRM framework.

classes.name: DrmEngineBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing an interface for DRM plugin implementations, including methods for content constraints, metadata, rights management, decryption, and support info.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves DRM constraints for specific content and actions.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for specific content.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DRM plugin session.

methods.name: setOnInfoListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for DRM info events.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the DRM plugin session.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the plugin can handle specific content.

methods.name: processDrmInfo
methods.description: Processes DRM information requests.

methods.name: saveRights
methods.description: Saves DRM rights to a specified path.

methods.name: acquireDrmInfo
methods.description: Retrieves DRM info for registration or rights acquisition.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of content.

methods.name: getDrmObjectType
methods.description: Gets the type of DRM object (content, rights, etc.).

methods.name: checkRightsStatus
methods.description: Checks rights validity for content.

methods.name: consumeRights
methods.description: Consumes rights for content, with optional reservation.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Informs DRM engine of playback status changes.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates if an action on content is permitted.

methods.name: removeRights
methods.description: Removes rights for specific content.

methods.name: removeAllRights
methods.description: Removes all rights.

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Starts a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: convertData
methods.description: Converts DRM data during a session.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Ends a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: getSupportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves DRM support capabilities.

methods.name: openDecryptSession
methods.description: Opens a decryption session with various overloads.

methods.name: closeDecryptSession
methods.description: Closes an active decryption session.

methods.name: initializeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Initializes decryption for a content unit.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption on content buffers.

methods.name: finalizeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Finalizes decryption for a content unit.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads bytes from an open DRM content.
